# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 25 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Q2 2026 Market Data: Private Homes & HDB Resale

- **Private home prices rose 0.5% in Q2 2026, led by landed homes** - URA's latest figures show the overall private residential property price index increased 0.5% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 2026, easing from the 0.9% gain in Q1, with landed homes driving the increase. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-q2-2026-report-breakdown/)

- **Condo price growth at its weakest first-half pace since 2020** - URA's Q2 2026 data shows non-landed prices dipped even as resale transactions drove a 13.6% rise in total sales volume, marking the slowest first-half growth for the segment since 2020. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-condo-prices-just-had-their-slowest-first-half-since-2020/)

- **HDB resale prices slipped 0.3% in Q2 2026 — second consecutive quarterly decline** - HDB's Resale Price Index fell 0.3% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 2026, continuing a two-quarter softening trend, even as transaction volumes edged higher. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-prices-fell-in-q2-2026-as-market-continues-to-stabilise/)

- **Million-dollar HDB flat sales hit a record 491 units in Q2 2026** - Despite the overall HDB resale price index declining for a second straight quarter, the number of flats transacted at S$1 million or above reached a new record high in the same period. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fall-for-a-second-straight-quarter-but-million-dollar-flat-sales-just-hit-a-record-high/)

## New Launches & Land Sales

- **Lentor Gardens Residences sells 270 of 499 units on launch day at average S$2,350 psf** - The Kingsford Group project achieved a 54% take-up rate on its 18 July 2026 launch day, with 270 units sold at an average price of S$2,350 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/lentor-gardens-residences-sells-270-units-at-an-average-of-s2350-psf/)

- **Bayshore Drive GLS site awarded to Frasers-led consortium at S$1,323 psf ppr** - URA awarded the Bayshore Drive mixed-use Government Land Sale tender on 20 July 2026 to Gemini Residential Pte. Ltd., the highest of three bids received, at S$1,323 psf per plot ratio. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bayshore-drive-gls-1280-homes-integrated-mrt/)

## Upcoming BTO & Notable Transactions

- **October 2026 BTO exercise to offer 7,970 flats across seven projects** - Sites include two Bayshore locations near Bayshore MRT, a likely Prime-classified project in Toa Payoh, and Tengah's first BTO launch in three years, among others. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/we-review-the-october-2026-bto-launch-sites/)

- **District 5 resale profit record set at S$5.4 million for boutique condo unit** - A 4-bedroom unit at The Peak on Pepys Road sold for S$8.5 million in early July 2026, generating a S$5.4 million capital gain and setting a new resale profit record for District 5. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/d5-boutique-condo-sets-district-resale-profit-record-at-s5-4-million/)
